column1: Table 3.9 Balance Sheet of Hungarian Central Bank or State Note Institute in millions of kronen
Note: Figures prior to June 1924 are those of the State Note Institute. The Hungarian
National Bank opened 24 June 1924 and took over the affairs of the institute.
After June 1924 gold and silver holdings are shown in terms of paper crowns.
Other changes were also made in the presentation of accounts after the opening
of the new Hungarian National Bank in June.
